settings.title: Experts You Can Count On for Heating, Cooling & Plumbing

settings.editor:
Why do homeowners throughout Sumner County and Middle
Tennessee trust us for all of their home service needs?

settings.title: Family-Owned, Certified & Here to Offer Personalized Service

settings.editor:
When it comes to serving home and business owners with professionalism, respect, and excellence, we hit all the marks. We leave our job sites looking better than when we arrived, and as a family-owned and community-oriented establishment, you can rest assured knowing your needs, wishes, and safety will always come first.

We take pride in being bonded, licensed, and insured, and we have over 100 hours of training at the Tennessee Technology Center under our belts. Combine that with our Mechanical License, our EPA Certification, and our Compressed Gas Certification, and you’ve got a team that’s ready for anything.

Long story short – we’re here to ensure you get the highest level of care possible.

icon_list.text: Fast response with honest, upfront service

settings.title: A Family-Owned Company Focused on People, Not Just Systems

settings.editor:
Founded as a family business in 2010, Petitt Heating & Cooling was built with a clear purpose: create a workplace where employees can thrive while delivering exceptional service to the community. What began as a one-person operation has grown into a trusted local company with dedicated service technicians, installation crews, and office staff.

The company emphasizes professionalism, respect, transparency, and a commitment to going beyond “good enough” on every job.

settings.title: Built by Experience, Led as a Family

settings.editor:
Petitt Heating & Cooling is owned by Mike and Trina Petitt. Mike brings over 30 years of HVAC industry experience, having worked as an installer, service technician, and project manager before launching the company after 17 years with a large HVAC firm. Trina plays a central leadership role in the business and is recognized as the operational backbone of the company.

Married for over 26 years, they have grown the company together while raising their three sons, building a business grounded in stability, values, and long-term vision.

settings.title:
Rooted in Our Community, 
Committed to Giving Back

settings.editor: We believe in making a difference in the homes we serve and the community around us. Through the Chamber of Commerce, FCA, and support for local schools, we’re committed to helping the people and organizations that shape Sumner County and beyond.

Behind every service call and every solution is a team that genuinely cares. Our leadership brings experience, steady guidance, and a shared commitment to doing things the right way—for our customers, our employees, and our community.

At Petitt Heating & Cooling, we stand behind our word and our work. This is our personal
commitment to your home’s comfort and your family’s well-being.

icon_list.text: The $500 Installation Guarantee: We respect your time. If our team does not show up on your scheduled installation day, we will pay you $500.
10-Year Peace of Mind: We don’t just install it—we stand by it. New installations include a full 10-year parts and labor warranty to protect your investment
12-Hour Priority Response We don't leave our neighbors in the heat or the cold. If your primary system fails, we guarantee a technician will be at your door within 12 hours.
Certified Expertise: Our team holds TN Mechanical Licenses and EPA Certifications with over 50 years of combined industry experience.

settings.editor: We’re known for being honest, respectful, and thorough, offering the best HVAC and plumbing services throughout Sumner County, Davidson County, and Robertson County. If you own a home or business, be sure to trust in us for it all.
